parent: The already-selected quantity_obligation support owner, risk_budget0.10 and two positions. Do not incorporate unmeasured opportunity-reassignment or protective-completion changes into this one-factor study.
diagnosis: Matched actual-fill attribution ending2025-12-31 reconciles all three selected accounts and incumbents to within3.1e-9 CNY and exactly reproduces all2181 selected close targets. Common-five log wealth trails incumbent by0.21789843118168112; February2023 contributes minus0.08935797100686099. The parent first funds positions on2023-02-08, while the incumbent can fund from2023-01-19 using its ten-observation minimum. These observed differences motivate a test, not a claim that every early admission would be profitable. Later full-capacity gaps are a separate already-registered opportunity-reassignment study and are not duplicated here.
hypothesis: Permit an expanding estimate before the support owner's full twenty-observation window matures, using the existing Config.fast minimum, currently10. This may avoid unnecessary initial/newly-listed underparticipation while retaining the same twenty-session estimator once enough observations exist. The old twenty-observation rule was a valid design choice, not a correctness bug.
rule: Keep the current true-range formula and rolling20-session ATR window, but set min_periods to Config.fast. Keep the same prior-close rolling20-session support window, with min_periods Config.fast. Admission readiness requires a currently quoted positive-volume session, at least Config.fast actual positive-volume quotes since first observation, finite ATR and support, and the parent's unchanged entry, exit, score, risk and readmission conditions. No earlier dates, pre-2023 warmup, fabricated quotes or IPO backfill may be used. A missing previous close cannot create a true-range observation. Future bars and removed securities must not affect earlier features or decisions.
unchanged: All old modules and contracts remain intact. Keep the selected parent's stop distance, nondecreasing stop ratchet, holdings, risk warning/history/recovery authority, economic-ceiling-versus-declaration correction, pending obligations, concentration, ranking, cash, fees, next-open execution, T+1, materiality and minimum-lot rules. No membership reassignment, forecast fit, new window search, date rule or stock/sector key is introduced.
selection: Exactly one fixed candidate. Keep finite_study's existing pre-2026 cutoff, three core scopes, incumbent wealth/drawdown/fill minimax deficit, objective and tie-break. Preserve every raw result and predecessor. A necessary screen is not the original four-reference or robustness acceptance.
evaluation: Use the same selected candidate for unchanged full, bull, late-June-through-August, July-August and retrospective-2026 windows. Original native-reference, pool/removal/subset/cost/delay/prefix and joint economic requirements remain mandatory. Do not combine results from different candidates or call previously inspected2026 out of sample.
verification: one fixed candidate without searched parameters
no readiness before actual observation minimum
no true range from a missing predecessor
twenty-observation estimates agree with the unchanged parent
missing-volume and stale sessions remain inadmissible
pending economic ceilings and actual cash remain binding
source-bound intent traces and strict cache identity
limitations: Shorter estimation history may increase noise, turnover or losses, especially around listings. This hypothesis does not establish profitability, a realized loss bound, universal superiority, or actual-share/corporate-action/tax accounting. The adjusted-unit engine remains a research proxy.
